lantern.name: Family Lantern
lantern.desc: The Lantern that lets Mio Shift between the Near and Far Shores.

honey.name: Honey
honey.desc: Restores 70 HP. Also a lovely offering: spirits with a sweet tooth adore it.

hush_bell.name: Hush Bell
hush_bell.desc: Ring softly: no wandering spirits for 60 steps. (Present in the build; absent from spec — adopted.)

dust_pouch.name: Dust Pouch
dust_pouch.desc: Soot and dust from a Dust Wisp. Sells for a little.

wish_scrap.name: Wish Scrap
wish_scrap.desc: A scrap of paper with half a wish on it. Dropped by Sent spirits.

bell_shard.name: Bell Shard
bell_shard.desc: A chip of bronze that still hums faintly.

shrine_key.name: Shrine Key
shrine_key.desc: The Well Spirit's gift. It opens the Bell Shrine gate.

wind_chime.name: Kiku's Wind-chime
wind_chime.desc: Kiku's lost wind-chime. It tinkles with Far Shore light.

hanzo_note.name: Ghost's Message
hanzo_note.desc: A message from the other shore, to be told aloud to Hanzo.

lucky_knot.name: Lucky Knot
lucky_knot.desc: A knot of red cord. AGI +3.

spirit_charm.name: Spirit Charm
spirit_charm.desc: Given by a grateful ghost. MDF +4, MAT +3.

cucumber.name: Cucumber
cucumber.desc: Offering: a kappa's favourite. Also heals 20 HP.

lantern_oil.name: Lantern Oil
lantern_oil.desc: Mio: +25 Lumen. Also a favoured Offering for light spirits.

antidote_salt.name: Antidote Salt
antidote_salt.desc: Cure Burn, Chill, Wilt on one ally.

ward_salt.name: Ward Salt
ward_salt.desc: Remove one Hollow Touch stack from one ally.

smoke_ball.name: Smoke Ball
smoke_ball.desc: Escape from a normal battle (not bosses).

paper_charm.name: Paper Charm
paper_charm.desc: Offering: paper-crafts, loved by paper spirits.

milk_bowl.name: Milk Bowl
milk_bowl.desc: Offering: a bowl for household spirits.

memento.name: Memento
memento.desc: Offering: a small remembered thing; archive spirits love these.

flower_bundle.name: Flower Bundle
flower_bundle.desc: Offering: flowers; wilted ones are weaker.

shrine_bell_clapper.name: Shrine Bell Clapper
shrine_bell_clapper.desc: Hung at the shrine to ring true.

charm1.name: Ward Charm
charm1.desc: Daigo no longer Thinned in the Far Shore.

kappa_ointment.name: Kappa Ointment
kappa_ointment.desc: Cures Stun/Bound; heals 100. (Reclassified from "equip": it is a consumable reward of the Kappa Toll-Keeper.)

anvil_core.name: Anvil Core
anvil_core.desc: Catalyst. The Hundred-Year Anvil's heart: re-forges the Ward Charm into Ward Charm+. (Reclassified from "equip".)

garden_core.name: Garden Core
garden_core.desc: Catalyst. A heartbeat of stone-and-bloom: forged into the Garden-Bloom Staff. (Reclassified from "equip".)

hanami_dango.name: Hanami Dango
hanami_dango.desc: Three sticks for the whole party: heal each ally 40 HP.

kuzu_tonic.name: Kuzu Tonic
kuzu_tonic.desc: Heal 60 HP and cure Chill / Burn / Wilt on one ally.

umeboshi.name: Umeboshi
umeboshi.desc: Pickled plum: cure Dazed, Blind, Bound, Stun on one ally.

sun_mochi.name: Sun Mochi
sun_mochi.desc: Heal the whole party 120 HP and cure Hollow Touch x1.

lantern_feast.name: Lantern Feast
lantern_feast.desc: Heal the whole party 300 HP; restore 40 SP each.

dawn_dew.name: Dawn Dew
dawn_dew.desc: Full-restore one ally HP and cure all ailments (not Hollow Touch).

clear_tonic.name: Clear Tonic
clear_tonic.desc: Remove all stacks of Hollow Touch from one ally.

firecracker.name: Firecracker
firecracker.desc: Flame damage 40 to all enemies (fixed; ignores DEF).

salt_pouch.name: Salt Pouch
salt_pouch.desc: Lumen damage 90 to one enemy; x2 vs Hollowed.

bitter_pill.name: Bitter Pill
bitter_pill.desc: Cure Dazed/Stun and grant Nimble 3 turns to one ally.

soothing_bell.name: Soothing Bell
soothing_bell.desc: Parley: all enemies Mood +20 (once per enemy).

veil_paper.name: Veil Paper
veil_paper.desc: Deal 2 VP damage to one Veiled enemy and mark it.

paper_crane.name: Paper Crane
paper_crane.desc: Fold and release: leave the current dungeon (not bosses), returns to its entrance.

homeward_crane.name: Homeward Crane
homeward_crane.desc: Warp to the last lit Lantern Post you used (Near or Far).

dew_vial.name: Dew Vial
dew_vial.desc: Peek at the other Shore for 8 seconds without spending Lumen (needs Dew Lens).

wick_trim.name: Wick Trim
wick_trim.desc: Mio: +5 Lumen; use at a Lantern Post to refill Lumen fully for free (post refills are free anyway).

origami_crane.name: Origami Crane
origami_crane.desc: Offering: a folded paper bird; craft-lovers adore it.

sakura_mochi.name: Sakura Mochi
sakura_mochi.desc: Offering: sweet rice cake with cherry leaf (+HP 40).

river_trout.name: River Trout
river_trout.desc: Offering: a grilled trout; cats and kappa agree.

rice_wine_gourd.name: Rice-Wine Gourd
rice_wine_gourd.desc: Offering: a small gourd of sake (tanuki, oni, tengu).

small_bell.name: Small Bell
small_bell.desc: Offering: a bell the size of a thumb; sound-lovers.

temple_incense.name: Temple Incense
temple_incense.desc: Offering: calms light-sensitive and grieving spirits.

fresh_cucumber_set.name: Cucumber Basket
fresh_cucumber_set.desc: Offering: five good cucumbers (kappa +, others neutral).

faded_photograph.name: Faded Photograph
faded_photograph.desc: Offering: someone's remembered face; archive spirits weep.

hearth_milk.name: Hearth Milk
hearth_milk.desc: Offering: warm milk for household spirits.

night_lamp_oil.name: Night Lamp Oil
night_lamp_oil.desc: Mio: +30 Lumen. Offering for light spirits.

forge_flux.name: Forge Flux
forge_flux.desc: Daigo's flux: removes the gold cost of one forge step this chapter (max 1 use per chapter).

source.how: Peaceful resolution (Calm + Send) or forge-win bonus; also Tsubaki scene
Optional Hundred-Step Stair (z24) — Calm + Invite or win

garden_core_staff.name: Garden-Bloom Staff
garden_core_staff.desc: Relic: MAT 20, Bloom +10% (made from the Garden Core).

source.how: Forge Garden Core into Moonlit Lantern-Staff at the Ashiro forge (Ch8)

day_cloak_1.name: Near-Day Cloak
day_cloak_1.desc: Near Shore: DEF 11; Far Shore: DEF 2.

far_shawl_1.name: Far-Shore Shawl
far_shawl_1.desc: Far Shore: DEF 4 / MDF 8; Near: DEF 2.

day_cloak_2.name: Near-Day Cape
day_cloak_2.desc: Near Shore: DEF 16; Far Shore: DEF 3.

far_shawl_2.name: Far-Shore Mantle
far_shawl_2.desc: Far Shore: DEF 6 / MDF 12; Near: DEF 3.

day_cloak_3.name: Near-Day Mantle
day_cloak_3.desc: Near Shore: DEF 22; Far Shore: DEF 4.

far_shawl_3.name: Far-Shore Veil-Cloak
far_shawl_3.desc: Far Shore: DEF 8 / MDF 16; Near: DEF 4.

charm_bloom.name: Bloom Charm
charm_bloom.desc: Resist Wilt 50% (free copy from Willow Mother peace).

ward_charm_plus.name: Ward Charm+
ward_charm_plus.desc: Daigo no longer Thinned; Hollow Touch resist 50%.

source.how: Daigo re-forges the Ward Charm with the Anvil Core (Ch5)

c_wellwater_locket.name: Wellwater Locket
c_wellwater_locket.desc: Recover 3% max HP at end of each turn in battle.

source.how: Given by Granny Sachi in the Ch6 flashback
Reward for the Ch8 "Lantern Night Procession" side quest

elder_seal.name: Elder Matsu's Seal
elder_seal.desc: A red seal the village guards respect after dark.

dew_lens.name: Dew Lens
dew_lens.desc: A drop of well-water in a brass ring. Look through it to see the other Shore.

collectors_book.name: Keeper's Ledger
collectors_book.desc: A cloth-bound ledger. Every Sent soul leaves a line.

wellkeeper_pebble.name: Wellkeeper's Pebble
wellkeeper_pebble.desc: A smooth river pebble that is always damp.

anchor_stone.name: Anchor Stone
anchor_stone.desc: A heavy grey stone that refuses to drift.

toll_token.name: Toll Token
toll_token.desc: A worn bronze coin with a hole in it.

wick_forest.name: Whisper Wick
wick_forest.desc: A lantern wick that burns without smoke. Use to raise max Lumen +10 (70).

remembrance_cord.name: Remembrance Cord
remembrance_cord.desc: A cord of knotted names. Tie it to a Hollowed person to feel their name.

oto_bell.name: Oto's Bell
oto_bell.desc: A tiny bell on a worn collar.

willow_sprig.name: Willow Sprig
willow_sprig.desc: A sprig that wants to be planted.

veil_sash.name: Veil Sash
veil_sash.desc: A sash that makes you look like you belong in the Night Market.

wick_market.name: Market Wick
wick_market.desc: A wick sold to travelers who can't afford oil. Max Lumen +10 (80).

punt_pole.name: Punt Pole
punt_pole.desc: A long pole for pushing flat boats.

charm_cord.name: Charm Cord
charm_cord.desc: A braided cord with a loop.

parade_ticket.name: Parade Ticket
parade_ticket.desc: A scrap of paper marked "Admit one soul".

wick_forge.name: Forge Wick
wick_forge.desc: A wick lit from the Hundred-Year Anvil. Max Lumen +10 (90).

quench_flask.name: Quench Flask
quench_flask.desc: A flask of cold well-water that never empties on the Near side.

cinder_lamp.name: Cinder Lamp
cinder_lamp.desc: A hooded lamp with a foxfire inside.

anvil_heart.name: Anvil Heart
anvil_heart.desc: A glowing coal the size of a fist, hammered flat.

sachi_ember.name: Sachi's Ember
sachi_ember.desc: A tiny coal that remembers her voice.

lantern_shard_hearth.name: Shard of Hearth
lantern_shard_hearth.desc: A shard that smells of rice and smoke.

lantern_shard_name.name: Shard of Names
lantern_shard_name.desc: A shard covered in names that tire the eye.

full_lantern.name: Rekindled Lantern
full_lantern.desc: The Family Lantern, mended with ember and shards. It burns with both lights.

marigold_garland.name: Marigold Garland
marigold_garland.desc: A garland of fresh marigolds, glowing orange.

thaw_candle.name: Thaw Candle
thaw_candle.desc: A candle that burns warm even when it is cold.

guardian_pebble.name: Guardian's Pebble
guardian_pebble.desc: A pebble from the base of the Guardian.

readers_card.name: Reader's Card
readers_card.desc: A card granting entry to the Archive Index.

ancestor_comb.name: Ancestor's Comb
ancestor_comb.desc: A comb with a tooth missing.

procession_lantern.name: Procession Lantern
procession_lantern.desc: A small paper lantern that glows with many names.

ks_amabie.name: Amabie's Scale Locket
ks_amabie.desc: A prophet's scale; hold it to call her Foretelling.

ks_kettle.name: Brownie's Ladle
ks_kettle.desc: A tiny wooden ladle that smells of soup.

ks_tengu.name: Tengu's Small Fan
ks_tengu.desc: A pocket fan; a flick starts a gale.

lantern_shard.name: Lantern Shard
lantern_shard.desc: A piece of the shattered Lantern. Five pieces are needed.
